title: I Asked Meta Muse to Fix an Issue With My Phone Provider. It Got Blocked at Every Turn
key_facts: A CNET writer asked Meta's Muse AI agent to confirm they are the formal owner of their Visible phone number, which keeps getting spam calls and texts for a previous owner called Andrew.
Visible is the all-digital low-cost plan from Verizon, $25 a month, with no number to call.
Muse found a data-broker page listing the number but was blocked because Visible blocks bot visits; its guest-chat workaround also failed.
Muse drafted a message for the writer to send to Visible manually and advised asking data brokers such as WhitePages to remove records.
Visible's advanced support later told the writer to keep the browser open for 4 to 24 hours; the problem was not fixed.
The writer concludes many websites block AI agents, so Muse still feels like a regular chatbot giving guidance.
quote_evidence: Muse couldn't get through, as Visible blocks bot visits.
With a lot of these websites blocking AI agents, it makes autonomous task completion a challenge.
For me, in this situation, Muse still feels like a regular chatbot, giving guidance for me to follow.
why_it_matters_hint: A first-person test shows AI agents are limited by sites that block bots.
notes: First-person review by one writer; test date not stated.
